text:
deploy-bot: Started staged rollout for release v2.3.1-rc4 -> 10% traffic in eu-west at 1764123456. Rollout ID: r-9123. Watch window 15m. Logs/metrics: https://grafana.redwood/reports/r-9123 :rocket:

sam: seeing a small cluster of 502s from router-a-3 around +3m, nothing huge but correlated with p95 up ~120ms. Link: https://grafana.redwood/d/qps?panelId=7 :eyes:

jessie: noted, any config changes in this build that touch kvcache or router timeouts?

miguel: yes, this build bumped kv-cache prefetch to 128 from 64. There's also an eager warmup patch for prefix caching. Could increase mem pressure on smaller pods.

ops-oncall: can we get pod OOMs? checked node metrics — no OOMs reported, but container RSS is higher by ~18% on canary instances.

sam: ok let's run a quick diff: `kubectl -n inference get deploy router-a-3 -o yaml | grep -i limits -A3` and check k8s events. I'll run and paste results.

sam: ```
Events:
  Warning  BackOff  2m (x3 over 5m)  kubelet  Back-off restarting failed container
  Normal   Pulled   3m                kubelet  Successfully pulled image
```

jessie: that's not OOM but restart spikes. Could be gRPC handshake failures if mem pressure leads to GC pauses.

alicia: from the canary perf dashboard, our p99 token latency for gen calls is at +400ms vs baseline 180ms on eu-west 1. Error rate still low (0.8%), but tail latency is concerning for SLO.

miguel: propose we PAUSE the progressive rollout to 0% in eu-west while we triage. We can keep other regions at 10% if unaffected. Thoughts? :warning:

deploy-bot: Action queued: set rollout r-9123 region=eu-west state=paused by system_request. Waiting for confirmation.

sam: +1 to pause eu-west. We should pin traffic so no half-rolled pods get replaced. Command to pin: `redwoodctl rollout pin --id r-9123 --region eu-west --version v2.3.0-stable`

jessie: i'll run the pin and scale down new replica set to 0 for eu-west after pin. Doing it now. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jessie: done — pinned to v2.3.0-stable in eu-west and scaled new rs to 0. Verified `kubectl get rs` shows 0 new pods.

ops-oncall: monitoring — p99 dropping back toward baseline within 2 minutes. No OOMs during scale action. Reactions: :thumbsup:

alicia: creating a tracking ticket with perf traces and adding regression flag. Also attaching release notes snippet for RC4 that mentions kv-cache change so product knows: https://confluence.redwood/releases/v2.3.1-rc4

miguel: next steps — revert eager prefetch in a patch build, run canary again limited to 2 nodes with extended tracing, or tweak JVM GC flags to reduce pauses. I'll open a PR with revert branch.

sam: agree. For the short term, we'll keep eu-west pinned and other regions at rollout=10% but under close watch. Change window note: this is within the 48h change window; coordinating with product for any customer-impacting comms.

deploy-bot: Rollout r-9123 (eu-west) paused at 1764123530 by jessie. Other regions: active.

jessie: tagging @release-manager and @product for visibility. Also scheduling a quick 10m sync in #eng-releases in 5m to decide rollback vs patch plan.

sam: thanks — will add logs and the `kubectl describe` outputs to the ticket. If the revert PR lands clean we can attempt a small canary tomorrow afternoon during off-peak.

alicia: noted. I'll update the customer-facing change log draft to mention a paused rollout and potential short maintenance note if rollback is needed.

miguel: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inc/release/pull/447 — revert prefetch change. Assigning reviewers.

ops-oncall: leaving monitoring alerts in play. If error rate >1.5% or p99 > 500ms for 3m, we'll escalate and consider full rollback.

sam: closing thread for now, follow-ups in ticket RED-2341. Thanks all. :v:
